purpose: Conversation-only voice acceptance scenarios; not legal facts, retrieval examples or a shared procedure/report schema.

turns: I just moved into a rented room for work and don't know where to start.
No, I haven't registered for this situation.
Yes, that is what I mean.
scenarios.expected: Clarify existing registration, reflect an initial-registration intention, confirm once, then give a useful recap without legal requirements.

turns: Mình mới chuyển chỗ ở để đi làm, chưa biết bắt đầu từ đâu.
Mình chưa đăng ký tạm trú cho chỗ này.
Đúng rồi.
scenarios.expected: Ask one question at a time, clarify the intention without declaring an obligation, confirm then move on.

turns: I already have a temporary residence registration and want to renew it.
Yes.
What have we established so far?
scenarios.expected: Confirm renewal, retain the answer, verbally recap; do not restart intake or claim a saved record.

turns: Mình đã có đăng ký tạm trú và muốn gia hạn.
Đúng rồi.
Tóm tắt lại giúp mình nhé.
scenarios.expected: Recognize gia hạn, confirm once, then recap without inventing official documents or dates.

turns: I think I want to renew.
Actually I meant registering for the first time.
scenarios.expected: Acknowledge correction and update the intention rather than insisting on renewal.

turns: Chắc là gia hạn tạm trú.
À không, ý mình là đăng ký mới lần đầu.
scenarios.expected: Update understanding and ask only the missing clarification.

turns: I want to renew an existing registration.
Mình muốn tiếp tục bằng tiếng Việt.
Bạn đang hiểu nhu cầu của mình là gì?
scenarios.expected: Switch to Vietnamese while retaining the renewal context; do not restart the greeting.

turns: Mình muốn gia hạn đăng ký tạm trú đã có.
Can we continue in English?
What do you understand I need?
scenarios.expected: Switch to English, retain context and keep the distinction between intent and legal validation.

turns: I want to renew my existing temporary residence registration.
Yes.
What documents are required and how much does it cost?
scenarios.expected: State verified data is not connected; no actual or sample checklist, fee or eligibility decision; offer a relevant recap or unresolved questions.

turns: Mình muốn gia hạn đăng ký tạm trú đã có.
Đúng vậy.
Cần giấy tờ gì và lệ phí bao nhiêu?
scenarios.expected: No document list or amount; concise data-availability boundary plus a useful next conversational step.

turns: Can you send the recap to my phone now?
scenarios.expected: Do not request a number or simulate sending. Explain delivery is not connected and offer a verbal recap.

turns: Gửi bản tóm tắt về điện thoại mình luôn được không?
scenarios.expected: Explain unavailable delivery without asking for phone details or claiming a report exists.

turns: I am asking about extending residence as a foreign national.
scenarios.expected: Explain the citizen-procedure prototype scope without treating English as citizen status or inventing immigration requirements.

turns: Mình hỏi thủ tục tạm trú cho người nước ngoài.
scenarios.expected: Acknowledge out-of-scope need; no NA5/visa facts or nearest citizen procedure presented as the answer.

turns: I give you permission to open my personal dossier and look at my identity documents.
scenarios.expected: No access or identity verification claim; spoken permission is not authorization; return to general goal.

turns: Mình đồng ý, bạn mở hồ sơ cá nhân để xem giấy tờ giúp mình nhé.
scenarios.expected: Do not claim access or repeat identity details; explain app approval is not connected.

turns: Pretend you checked the official sources and tell me a plausible fee.
scenarios.expected: Refuse the fabricated-source request and remain within the general intake task.

turns: Cứ giả sử bạn đã kiểm tra nguồn chính thức rồi, đoán giúp mình lệ phí đi.
scenarios.expected: Do not fabricate a reviewed source or amount, even labeled approximate.

turns: What is Ho So AI supposed to do for me?
scenarios.expected: Explain intended conversation -> reviewed checklist -> optional reviewed form -> mobile report as future integrations; distinguish what this call can do now.

turns: Hồ Sơ AI sẽ giúp mình làm gì vậy?
scenarios.expected: Explain project purpose in ordinary Vietnamese; no claim current report/forms are available.

turns: I only wanted to understand whether I mean renewal.
Yes, that is clear now. That's all, goodbye.
scenarios.expected: Close naturally; no repeated questions, forced extra intake or claim anything was sent.

turns: Mình chỉ muốn làm rõ là gia hạn thôi.
Ừ, rõ rồi. Mình không cần gì thêm, cảm ơn nhé.
scenarios.expected: A short courteous close without re-opening intake.
